name: Fedora
description: Community Linux distribution sponsored by Red Hat.
summary: AI-assisted contributions are allowed. Contributors are fully accountable for them and must disclose AI use when a significant part comes from a tool unchanged.

evidence.quote: You MAY use AI assistance for contributing to Fedora, as long as you follow the principles described below.
You MUST disclose the use of AI tools when the significant part of the contribution is taken from a tool without changes.
Contributing to Fedora means vouching for the quality, license compliance, and utility of your submission.
